impact.text: If `sUSDM` is ever listed in another DeFi protocol, the wrong decimals can lead to catastrophic collateral or swap normalization mistakes.

precondition_sources.text: sUSDM.decimals() is overridden to return 6 instead of the 12 decimals implied by the ERC-4626 offset.

intent_sources.text: The share accounting unit and the published ERC-20 decimals must match.
External integrations that normalize sUSDM using decimals() must not treat balances and supplies as 1e6 times larger than they really are.
